Extreme-event stress test

10th–90th percentile interval forecast

Quantile regression around the Polar Vortex.

Coverage inside the event window drops to 68% of actuals (target: 80%) — even a quantile model trained on history underestimates uncertainty during an unprecedented cold snap.

What the model actually leans on

Permutation importance on the final model. Note how little the synthetic temperature feature matters (see callout below) — an honest, expected result for a proxy feature.

The temperature feature is a synthetic proxy (no real weather API access in the build environment) and it shows: Model B (+temperature) improved on Model A by only 0.04% — essentially uncorrelated noise. Real historical weather data is the clear highest-value next step.

Demand data: real PJM East hourly load (Kaggle "hourly-energy-consumption"). Temperature is a synthetic proxy feature. Generated entirely by pjm_load_forecast.py — one file, no external data-fetching, dependency-free Parquet reader included.
